en.bdb: Association with the saints  the count of eight,  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਠਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aThakha(n)dd paakha(n)dd mat gurmat ik man ik dhiaaiaa|

en.bdb: The person conducting in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, goes beyond the hypocrisies of eight division (of four varnas and four ashramas) and adores the Lord with single minded devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: asaTadhaat paaras milee gurmukh ka(n)chan jot jagaiaa|

en.bdb: Eight metals in the form of four vamas and four religions having met the philosopher's stone in the form of Guru have convereted themselves into gold, the gurmukh, the enlightened one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾਂ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh sidh saadhikaa(n) aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: The siddhs and other miraculous practitioners have saluted to that primal Lord alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aThe pahar araadheeaai sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: That Lord ought to be adored all the eight watches of time; by merger of the consciousness in the Word, the imperceptible is perceived.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਕੁਲੀ ਵਿਹੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: asaT kulee vih utaree satigur mat na mohe maiaa|

en.bdb: By adopting the advice of the true Gum, the poison (stigma) of the eight generations is wiped out and now the intellect does not get deluded due to maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: man asaadh na saadheeaai gurmukh sukhafal saadh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs by their loving devotion have refined the incorrigible mind.
The mind is controlled only by meeting the holy congregation.
